label: exploratory comparison on previously examined E2 discovery history; E2's original daily panel used (sha256 checked), so the 'content identity unverified' caveat does not apply
question: Does one ATR trailing stop improve net returns of E2 CRYPTO G2_RET30 signals with next-UTC-day-open entries, and is the resulting strategy profitable in this historical test?

entries.overlap: skip, decided by the ORIGINAL exit
entries.controls: v2, 200 draws per attempted signal, seed 20261007+1

eligibility.atr_warmup: 15 consecutive daily bars s-14..s, finite, high>=low>0, close>0, ATR>0
eligibility.exclusion_window: day s-14 through the original exit day

arm_A: E2 harness 21345b1 original exit: close of entry+5 sessions or first later sellable session; EXIT_DATA_END at the last traded close

arm_B.atr: mean of 14 true ranges of daily bars s-13..s, first using close of s-14, frozen at entry
arm_B.initial_stop: entry - 3*ATR, active from the entry bar
arm_B.ratchet: after each completed hourly bar: highest=max(highest, high) from the entry price; stop=max(stop, highest-3*ATR) active from the next bar
arm_B.window: entry day 00:00 bar through the 23:00 bar of arm A's exit day
arm_B.gaps: hold; no fill or update while missing; gap rule on the next bar
arm_B.data_end: stops checked through the last bar; else arm A's price

costs.formula: exit*(1-c)/(entry*(1+c))-1, as E2's harness charges fee plus tier

statistics.cluster: ISO calendar week of the entry date (UTC)
statistics.interval: 95% percentile; one fixed set of resampled weeks for all metrics

sensitivities: conservative gap fills (first bar after a gap fills at its low)
data-end positions at -100% in both arms

criteria: C2 arm B mean net > 0 in each discovery year (entry year)
C3 lower 95% bound of arm B mean net > 0
C4 lower 95% bound of paired improvement > 0
C5 arm B mean excess over matched controls with the same exit > 0
C6 arm B mean net > 0 at stress costs

verdicts.Q1: IMPROVES if C4; DOES_NOT_IMPROVE if paired mean <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdicts.Q2: PROFITABLE_IN_THIS_HISTORICAL_TEST only if RESEARCH-POSITIVE; UNPROFITABLE if arm B mean net <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
